title: Remove reference-only directions before bounding arbitrary coherent perturbations
statement: For a strictly positive linearly independent IC primitive with mI<=M_i<=MI, connected graph slack k_ij(t)>=delta/(1+t) and L_G>=lambda(I-11^T/n), subtract the exact reference gauge X_i-J_(S_i)J_S^-1 X without restricting the original state pairs. Parallel-sum/Poincare bounds give SLD gap>=alpha S0, alpha=delta m lambda/(2M²). The stated inverse-perturbation budget K eta<alpha gives a FULL coherent neighbourhood of ordered POVM pairs, including signed/dense primitive coefficients.

requires: Exact rational column-stochastic channels with pair-supported output rows, or exact cancellation of common dense row rays leaving pair support
For quantum synthesis: an actually supplied common POVM; coherent neighbourhood additionally requires strictly positive linearly independent IC primitive, effect bounds and connected graph slack
Accepted N675 equivalence for every finite-dimensional channel pair: complete SLD versus UNRESTRICTED complete Umegaki on all finite untouched references and input-state pairs
provides: Accepted all-finite-reference quantitative inner design region in the full affine POVM-pair space
assumptions: IC primitive, strict effect bounds, graph slack and paid coefficient/operator-norm conversion required
Reference gauge removal is an identity, not an equal-reference-marginal condition
Qubit example per-effect operator radius1/70000000 and eta1/10000000 are conservative; no generic interior recognizer, optimized radius or measured device membership
Signed perturbations can leave the original nonnegative pair-row compiler while remaining inside this separate certified region
costs: Exact row coefficients/support discovery or common primitive acquisition are paid, not inferred from noisy measurement
Rational polynomial clearing/Sturm isolation and input-dependent witness margin/bit length; no reference-dimension search or free conditioning
Pauli primitive uses O(d²) settings/labels and O(d²) sparse output descriptions: exponential in qubit count q, even though at most q local measurements suffice per sampled readout
Ordinary Fisher/Hessian, binary positive-pencil calculus, Poincare and source-aware conventional implementations have the same inputs; no superiority established
contract.units: Full-reference SLD quadratic gap, dimensionless effect operator norms and exact graph/primitive coercivity; no finite-reference truncation.
contract.obstruction: A sparse-support criterion alone does not justify arbitrary coherent perturbations without coercivity on every nongauge direction.

body: Twenty-seven frozen Astra source/code/data files plus original FROZEN manifest acquired and hash-verified;20 third-party source-entry documents excluded. REVIEW_STATUS records substantive completed reviews of PROOF, COHERENT_NEIGHBOURHOOD and EXPANDER_DESIGN at their component scopes. The separately written PETZ_AND_COMPOSITION document has not received separate whole-written-source acceptance and is not used to enlarge those accepted scopes. Exact support/common primitive, all-reference gauge, physical acquisition, O(d²) settings/exponential qubit scaling, strong source-aware ordinary comparators and unknown priority remain. No generic order decision algorithm, uniform reference cutoff or physical/prediction advantage is inferred. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Actual acquired REVIEW_STATUS records completed substantive parent mathematical reviews of the three named components. Accepted N675 remains an input; separate whole-written-source acceptance of the Petz/composition document is not asserted.
